note:
From the Massachusetts lab (#83), which coloured roads by 28 metrics by joining values to roads by OSM way id. They included traffic (AADT), animal-crash risk, July high, January low, snow, foliage date and "old New England" (building ages).

The real app can colour roads only by what its packs carry: the scenic score's parts, grade and the like. So a metric from another layer can't be shown along the roads, across all regions.

The generalized lab (#100) found which metrics have worldwide data: monthly climate along roads and trails, sky darkness, peak-colour week, land cover and forest change, and built-up age.
text: From the lab: per-road metrics by way id (a build step that samples layers along each way into a per-z6 sidecar; the road shader's value mode), so roads can be coloured by traffic, climate, fall colour, history…
